verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an investor-facing portal or structured investor updates. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: segmented permissions for team members, a trading platform for employee participants, and a companyCaptable API that a developer could use to build such a portal. The axis applies to a cap table management product, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a founder, my investors get their own portal view of their holdings and can receive structured updates without emailing me for the cap table
